pre_psa_90.note: Typical: pre-combustion CO2 PSA ahead of the H2 PSA, 90 % capture (Rezaei/Crandall energy, Al Ghafri cost).

pre_psa_95.note: Pre-combustion CO2 PSA at 95 % capture (upper syngas capture, Al Ghafri et al.).

pre_mea_90.note: Pre-combustion MEA absorption at 90 % (Lin et al. 2024 intensified: 2.4 GJ/t reboiler, ~130 kWh/t), same unit cost.

post_amine_90.note: Single H2 PSA; tail gas burned; flue-gas amine capture of 90 % (workbook config 1 Typical: 2.4 GJ/t, 100 kWh/t, 80 USD/t).

no_capture.note: No capture at the reformer; all synthesis CO2 bought as non-fossil make-up (linear chain).

caption_notes: Gross EI shown; with non-fossil make-up CO2 every option nets to about zero (net EI pre_psa_90 +0.00, pre_psa_95 -0.00, pre_mea_90 +0.00, post_amine_90 +0.00, no_capture -0.00).
